args.title: Document field limits for report creation/update in API reference
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

The Reports section of the API reference doesn't state the validation limits enforced by src/api/reports.ts: `name` is max 120 characters, `categories` is at most 50 entries (each max 60 characters), and `schedule.recipients` is 1 to 20 email addresses. Add these limits to the Reports section (near the `POST /reports` and `schedule` description) so clients can validate before sending.

The limits are real and enforced in src/api/reports.ts but never documented: `name` ≤ 120 chars, `categories` ≤ 50 entries (each ≤ 60 chars), and `schedule.recipients` is 1–20 emails. Opened a PR to add these to the Reports section of the API reference.
